shots.what: old Hachiko, an Akita, sits by the entrance of Shibuya Station and looks up at each person who comes out
1924: Professor Ueno walks to Shibuya Station with young Hachiko; he goes inside and the dog sits to wait
a locked-off wide of the station plaza: spring to winter in seconds while crowds pass and the dog stays
evening: commuters stop to look; a station attendant brings the dog food
today: the bronze statue of Hachiko in the busy plaza, people meeting beside it
